been getting this question in DMs and comments so let me be clear. 

hermes agent is built by @NousResearch. when a research lab builds an agent framework the whole point is to get the full capability out of the model. 11 parsers, 30+ tools, skills system, all designed to extract everything the model can give.

for the best experience use it with frontier models through nous research. the difference between hermes + frontier and any other framework is not even close. i've used it with opus 4.6 and it was on another level.

it also runs beautifully on local models. i run on my gpus daily. but if you want the full power, pair it with the best model you can access. 

if you're still on openclaw it's time. i will personally help anyone migrating. you deserve better tools.
